verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents managed database offerings (structured relational databases with typed columns/relationships/indexes, dedicated PostgreSQL, shared or dedicated compute options) and provides client/server SDKs plus a CLI/type-generation tooling for interacting with data, with realtime updates supported. Independent community commentary corroborates Appwrite as a functioning self-hosted/managed BaaS with database features in production use, though most evidence is vendor docs rather than hands-on SDK usage examples. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of actual client+server SDK read/write code samples, and more detail on permissions model in practice.
